description: Siniestros que afectan al seguro del usuario en Red Propia (responsabilidad de la autopista) is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Caminos y Puentes Federales de Ingresos y Servicios Conexos (CAPUFE). Registro del número de siniestros del seguro de responsabilidad civil de la autopista que acontecen en los tramos de la Red Propia de CAPUFE. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Caminos y Puentes Federales de Ingresos y Servicios Conexos (CAPUFE). Its tags are accidente, carretera, carro, creación infraestructura, infraestructura transporte. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
